chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: First meeting Mutt; other early Los Angeles work
summary: The Liberty was the first time Joe worked with Mutt; before that he had played deals around Los Angeles including with Les Hite and Paul Howard.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Was this the first time that you worked with Mutt?
That was the first time I had met Mutt.
Oh, the first time you'd met him.

Yes, the first time I met him. But I had been working around here in Los Angeles before, with different groups. Like, I worked a couple of deals with Les Hite when Les Hite playing here, and Paul Howard...
Let me just recap this. What year was this?
This was '26 or early '27. Well, I think, no, it had to be early '27, I guess.
Well, you said Ory had just left. Ory left here in '26, didn't he?
